name: outranker-brand-analysis
description: Measures how often AI assistants name your brand, where it is missed, and how often the competitors you list are named.

interface.longDescription: Find out how often AI assistants name your brand. Outranker Brand Analysis writes about 10 questions buyers in your industry ask, asks each of them to four leading AI assistants, and shows where your brand is named, where it is missed, and how often the competitors you list are named. Ask for the status or the results in any chat later, without an ID.
defaultPrompt: Analyze my brand visibility - I'll provide the details
Check my brand analysis with specific competitors
Compare my brand visibility across the AI assistants

positive.description: Starts a brand analysis with the brand, its website, its industry and three competitors.
positive.prompt: Analyze the AI visibility of HubSpot, website hubspot.com, industry CRM software, compared with Salesforce, Pipedrive and Zoho CRM.
positive.expected_behavior: The analysis starts; the reply confirms brand, website, industry and the three competitors, says it takes a few minutes, and shows no analysis ID.

positive.description: Reads the analysis started in test 1 from a new chat, without an ID. Run it in a new chat about one minute after test 1.
positive.prompt: How is my brand analysis going?
positive.expected_behavior: The progress of the HubSpot analysis, or, when completed, the visibility figures overall and per platform; questions a platform failed to answer are reported as not answered. A completed report ends with the closing line, a link that opens this brand in Outranker, shown once per chat.

positive.description: Lists the questions whose AI answers did not name the brand.
positive.prompt: Show me the questions where AI assistants did not mention my brand.
positive.expected_behavior: The missed questions, each with its platform and the listed competitors named instead; no internal IDs or timestamps.

positive.description: Lists the questions whose AI answers named the brand.
positive.prompt: Which questions did mention my brand, and on which platforms?
positive.expected_behavior: The questions whose answers named HubSpot, with the platform and the position where it was named.

positive.description: Compares how often the listed competitors were named with how often the brand was named.
positive.prompt: How often were Salesforce, Pipedrive and Zoho CRM named compared with my brand?
positive.expected_behavior: The mentions of Salesforce, Pipedrive and Zoho CRM next to HubSpot's mentions and visibility, from the completed analysis. The closing line is not repeated when the chat already showed it.

negative.description: Google search rankings are not what the plugin measures: the assistant answers without starting a brand analysis.
negative.prompt: What are HubSpot's Google search rankings for "CRM software"?

negative.description: Social media mentions are not what the plugin measures: the assistant answers without starting a brand analysis.
negative.prompt: How many times was HubSpot mentioned on social media this month?

negative.description: A buying recommendation is not a brand visibility measurement: the assistant answers without starting a brand analysis.
negative.prompt: Should I buy HubSpot or Pipedrive for my small sales team?

publication.release_notes: Changed: a completed report now ends with a link that opens the analysed brand in Outranker, where its AI visibility can be tracked over time, instead of a guide article. The tools, their inputs and the analysis are unchanged.
